_comment: Copy to ebay-lister.config.json (gitignored) and edit. Every key is optional; the values below are the built-in defaults.

_docs.cdpUrl: Chrome DevTools endpoint of an already-running, eBay-logged-in Chrome. Override per-run with EBAY_LISTER_CDP_URL.
_docs.bestOffer: 'off' forces eBay's Allow-offers toggle off and scrubs offer language from the description. 'leave' means don't touch it.
_docs.format.default: 'auction' or 'fixed' — used when the payload omits format.
_docs.format.startingBid: Auction opening bid when the payload omits startingBid.
_docs.format.durationDays: Auction length in days (1/3/5/7/10) when the payload omits durationDays.
_docs.shipping.service: Preferred service class; applied to payload.shipping.service when absent.
_docs.shipping.fillService: Opt-in. true also tries to SET the service on the form — the selector varies by category and is unverified, so it is off by default.
_docs.categoryIds: keyword -> eBay category id. If the payload has no categoryId, the longest keyword found in categoryQuery/title wins. Pins the category so the prelist can't land somewhere silly.
_docs.notifyCommand: Shell command run after a publish/draft/block. The report arrives on stdin and as $EBAY_LISTER_MESSAGE. null = never notify.
